text: good idea, but poor interaction. text entry doesn't support the keyboards autocorrect, and the llm assistant is bad at understanding repeated edits to a single task or session. if the actual text entry and task creation could be streamlined, it could be really good. some examples: #1 support existing keyboard autocorrect #2 it should prompt to check if a suggested task list is incomplete or needs edits #3 it should prompt if it suspects typos, or an interrupted entry (hit enter early)
author: Mike Sherman
developer_reply: Thanks, Mike - this is genuinely helpful feedback. You’re absolutely right that task capture should feel effortless, especially in an ADHD planner. We’re reviewing the keyboard/autocorrect experience and how FOCO handles edits and incomplete entries. Your specific examples are incredibly useful and will help us improve the experience. 💜
